newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-COLLATED FIRST-ROUND SCORES AT PGA CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-COLLATED FIRST-ROUND SCORES AT PGA CHAMPIONSHIP.
